venue.notes: The map is a single sheet with no level labels; the pilot is modelled as one level ('L1', as drawn). Entrances visible on the sheet: 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 (all on the east side, facing parking). Entrances 1 and 2 are not visible, so the 'Centre Management near Entrance 2' landmark cannot be used. Only Entrance 4 is a start; instructions are written for the Entrance 4 → south direction only.

nodes.notes: README row 9 / G18: yellow unit labelled '37/38' on the west side of the walkway's southern end, just before Pick n Pay; the map shows the unit number, identity comes from the directory. Corridor ARRIVAL point, NOT the door.

instructions.forward: Pick n Pay is straight ahead at the end of the walkway.

edges.source: Official Garden Route Mall mall map (Webflow lightbox image on the shops page), original supplied by the mission owner 2026-09-03 [grm-map] (visual_first_party, confidence 0.75)
edges.notes: the walkway ends at the Pick n Pay block. length_px = Euclidean pixel distance between the two source-pixel positions on the 417×888 rendering (G19); shortest-path weight only, never a distance claim.

instructions.forward: Walk straight in from Entrance 4, past the ATMs on your left, until you reach the main walkway.

edges.source: Official Garden Route Mall mall map (Webflow lightbox image on the shops page), original supplied by the mission owner 2026-09-03 [grm-map] (visual_first_party, confidence 0.75)
edges.notes: inside the Entrance 4 passage between purple units 7/8 and 110/112; ATM markers 2b/2d lie in it. length_px = Euclidean pixel distance between the two source-pixel positions on the 417×888 rendering (G19); shortest-path weight only, never a distance claim.

instructions.forward: Continue along the walkway; the side passage on your left leads to Entrance 7.

edges.source: Official Garden Route Mall mall map (Webflow lightbox image on the shops page), original supplied by the mission owner 2026-09-03 [grm-map] (visual_first_party, confidence 0.75)
edges.notes: channel between yellow Edgars/30 (west) and blue 61/62 (east). length_px = Euclidean pixel distance between the two source-pixel positions on the 417×888 rendering (G19); shortest-path weight only, never a distance claim.

instructions.forward: Continue towards the end of the walkway; Clicks (37/38) is on your right just before Pick n Pay.

edges.source: Official Garden Route Mall mall map (Webflow lightbox image on the shops page), original supplied by the mission owner 2026-09-03 [grm-map] (visual_first_party, confidence 0.75)
edges.notes: channel between yellow 37/38 (west) and blue 45/50 (east). length_px = Euclidean pixel distance between the two source-pixel positions on the 417×888 rendering (G19); shortest-path weight only, never a distance claim.

instructions.forward: Turn left onto the main walkway and follow it, shops on both sides, until the first side passage on your left (it leads to Entrance 5).

edges.source: Official Garden Route Mall mall map (Webflow lightbox image on the shops page), original supplied by the mission owner 2026-09-03 [grm-map] (visual_first_party, confidence 0.75)
edges.notes: the walkway channel between red 12–16 (west) and purple 106–102 (east); continuous, no crossing. length_px = Euclidean pixel distance between the two source-pixel positions on the 417×888 rendering (G19); shortest-path weight only, never a distance claim.

instructions.forward: Cross the main walkway. Woolworths is directly ahead on the far side.

edges.source: Official Garden Route Mall mall map (Webflow lightbox image on the shops page), original supplied by the mission owner 2026-09-03 [grm-map] (visual_first_party, confidence 0.75)
edges.notes: Woolworths' east frontage faces the walkway opposite the passage; no store or wall is crossed. length_px = Euclidean pixel distance between the two source-pixel positions on the 417×888 rendering (G19); shortest-path weight only, never a distance claim.

instructions.forward: Continue straight along the walkway; the next side passage on your left leads to Entrance 6 and the cinema side.

edges.source: Official Garden Route Mall mall map (Webflow lightbox image on the shops page), original supplied by the mission owner 2026-09-03 [grm-map] (visual_first_party, confidence 0.75)
edges.notes: channel between red 17–19 / yellow 20–24 (west) and blue 92, 72, 74 (east); continuous. length_px = Euclidean pixel distance between the two source-pixel positions on the 417×888 rendering (G19); shortest-path weight only, never a distance claim.

instructions.forward: Keep following the walkway as it bends gently left; Edgars is on your right.

edges.source: Official Garden Route Mall mall map (Webflow lightbox image on the shops page), original supplied by the mission owner 2026-09-03 [grm-map] (visual_first_party, confidence 0.75)
edges.notes: channel between yellow 26/27 (west) and blue 71/69 (east). length_px = Euclidean pixel distance between the two source-pixel positions on the 417×888 rendering (G19); shortest-path weight only, never a distance claim.

instructions.forward: Keep going as the walkway bends left again, with the toilets on your left.

edges.source: Official Garden Route Mall mall map (Webflow lightbox image on the shops page), original supplied by the mission owner 2026-09-03 [grm-map] (visual_first_party, confidence 0.75)
edges.notes: channel between yellow 33/34 (west) and blue 54/56 (east); toilet symbol on the east side. length_px = Euclidean pixel distance between the two source-pixel positions on the 417×888 rendering (G19); shortest-path weight only, never a distance claim.
